label: Buffs
tooltip: Keep phantom job buffs up automatically.

should_automate_buffs.label: Automate buffs
should_automate_buffs.tooltip:
On: refresh selected buffs at knowledge crystals during Illegal Mode, and when Mob Farmer pauses for crystal buffs.
Off: no automatic buff refresh.

apply_buffs_using_inquiring_mind.label: Use Inquiring Mind when you can
apply_buffs_using_inquiring_mind.tooltip: Near a knowledge crystal, Freelancer can apply all selected unlocked buffs at once.
